scope: Actual gradient numerical attack with a lossless conic ROC SDP. No globally ROC-admitted separation without exact conic and global extension checks.

polynomial.scope: Numerical solution of the lossless conic ROC SDP. Strict negative candidates require rational conic Gram and global ROC extension, plus exact actual-field verification.
